concerns.text: The plan defers all modeling, evaluation, and interpretability steps because a verified joint SMILES + FQY dataset is unavailable, yet the core research question (predicting experimental fluorescence quantum yields from molecular structure) cannot be answered without such data. The document provides no concrete strategy to obtain a verified joint dataset, making it impossible to test the hypothesis or meet the success criteria (e.g., SC‑001, SC‑005) within the current methodology.
